$description: Generated by scripts/palettes.mts from themes/drive.tokens.json; do not edit. The Harbour palette in the Voice only theme.

paper.$description: Page ground behind every screen. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

surface.$description: Rows, cards, sheets and inputs that sit on paper. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

sunken.$description: Wells: the Gap bands in Today, the track of the Voice picker, collapsed lists. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

line.$description: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

line-strong.$description: Borders of inputs, toggles and outlined chips (3:1 on paper, surface and sunken in every theme). Not 3:1 on signal-soft in dark: marks inside a selected state use on-signal-soft.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons on paper, surface, sunken and signal-soft. The Do quadrant fill.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text on paper, surface and sunken: reason lines, metadata, timestamps.

signal.$description: The one action colour: the primary button, the selected tab, the Plan quadrant, links. As text (quiet buttons, links) it reads at 4.5:1 on paper and surface only, never on sunken; put on-signal text on a signal fill.

on-signal.$description: Text and icons on a signal fill.

signal-soft.$description: Selected and hovered backgrounds: the chosen segment, a selected row. Put on-signal-soft or ink text on it; ink-muted reads on it too (5.5:1+), so pressed rows keep their reason lines.

on-signal-soft.$description: Text on signal-soft, for the label of a selected segment or chip.

now.$description: Marigold. Marks the present: the current-time pill in Today, the Delegate quadrant, the Voice only chip. Always a fill with on-now text or icons on it; never text, a hairline or a bare mark on paper (1.6:1 on light paper).

on-now.$description: Text and icons on a now fill.

danger.$description: Overdue and destructive actions. As text it reads on paper and surface; on a fill use on-danger.

danger-soft.$description: Background of an Overdue badge or a failed-command banner. Put on-danger-soft text on it.

voice-1.$description: Silent: the fill of the first Voice meter bar, the lightest step of the ramp. Too light to stand alone (1.3:1 on light surface): a filled bar always keeps a voice-3 edge.

voice-2.$description: Out loud: the second bar of the Voice meter (3:1 on surface).

voice-3.$description: Closed door: the third bar of the Voice meter, the step that allows the most (3:1 on surface).

focus.$description: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, so it always lands on the ground (3:1 on paper and surface in every theme).

shadow-sheet.$description: Bottom sheets and the quick-add bar only; everything else is separated by line, not shadow. Voice only has no shadow: DTCG has no none value, so it is zero offsets, blur and spread in a fully transparent colour, and the extension marks it as none for CSS.
